handheld_console.lore.uncommon: Has a cracked screen corner that its owner insists makes it look cooler.

i_pinwheel.lore.common: Stops dead the moment you stop running, and refuses to spin standing still.

i_wig.lore.rare: Changes its wearer's whole personality, so every pirate wig produces a very loud pirate.

piggy_bank.lore.uncommon: Has a cork in its tummy that nobody is allowed to pull out until the summer holidays.

x_sand_bucket.lore.epic: Was filled with the whole beach's best shells, and the shell collectors followed it home.

x_toy_dinosaur.lore.uncommon: Has a wobbly head that nods yes to every question it's asked.

soccer_ball.lore.rare: Swerves away from the goalkeeper's gloves at the very last second, as if it has a mind of its own.

x_dice.lore.common: Shows a different number every time someone else checks it.

x_toy_robot_dog.lore.legendary: Was taken for a walk round the whole park on a lead, and three real dogs tried to make friends.
